## Slides

The slides for this week's lesson are available online as embedded HTML or PDF. Use the buttons below to open the slides either as an interactive website or as a static PDF (for printing or storing for later). You can also click in the slides below and navigate through them with your left and right arrow keys.

```{r show-slide-tabs, echo=FALSE, results="asis"}
#slide_buttons("/slides/01-slides")

xaringanExtra::embed_xaringan(
  "https://2026-psyc-259.github.io/5-automation-functions/#1",
  ratio = "16:9",
  border = "none",
  margin = "0 auto"
)
```

:::{.callout-tip}
Typing <kbd>?</kbd> (or <kbd>shift</kbd> + <kbd>/</kbd>) in the slide show brings slide navigation controls.
:::
